NOTIFICATION UNDER THE BOTANIC GARDENS ORDINANCE (CHAPTER 446)

BY virtue of power vested in the Section 2(2) of the Botanic Gardens Ordinance (Chapter 446) No. 31 of 1928 as amended bythe Act, No. 32 of 1973, I declare the Wet Zone Botanic Garden at Sitawaka, Awissawella which is described in the schedule,as a National Botanic Garden with effect from 25th March, 2015.
NAVIN DISSANAYAKE,Minister of Tourism and Sports.Ministry of Tourism and Sports,No. 09, Philip Gunawardene Mawatha,Colombo 07,18th March 2015.
Schedule
